encodings.statement: a data value is a frozen object whose $ property names its constructor and whose other properties are its fields
Rust primitive, array and algebraic arguments are validated recursively; strings contain Unicode scalars, fixed integers are BigInt and in range
every natural, integer and machine integer is a BigInt; machine-integer results are range-checked and throw RangeError where Rust would panic
a Number is a JavaScript Number, an IEEE-754 double, with its own arithmetic, comparisons and String conversion
